title: UD Croner FUPS Compliant Custom Built Polished Aluminium Bullbar #15
description: UD Croner hi-tensile FUPS compliant polished aluminium Bullbar. Heavy duty extra depth contoured main channel to suit driving lights & fog lights. Main cross tubes are one piece 76mm tube through drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Driving light mounts can be fitted to customer requirements.
